t: You're looking at the Serpentine Galleries, two contemporary art galleries in Kensington Gardens, now known simply as Serpentine and split between Serpentine South and Serpentine North. Two architects are linked to the place. James Grey West, who trained in Cardiff and later became chief architect at the Office of Works, designed one of the buildings. Zaha Hadid, the Iraqi-British architect who became a key figure in architecture from the late twentieth century onwards, designed another.
